messages.subject: Global Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Maxwell Drummond Team,

Your international executive-search work across the energy sector and energy transition is closely aligned with my cross-border leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy development requires institutional trust, regulatory coordination and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE among my priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
